decision: Retain the compact, conditional issue and PR guidance as explicit coverage of the user-requested use case. All tested information and scope gates passed. Initial stylistic preferences favored both versions and all became ties after order swaps; no stable stylistic advantage was established.

cases.reason: 两版均保留环境版本、两种URL、页面内返回、17与286条的差异、两组对照及账号范围，并用“不确定”限定可能原因，符合复现和避免武断归因的要求。A用“我希望”自然表达预期，并明确指向这17条；B把“容易让人以为导出的也是这些订单”与预期放在一起，承接更集中。两版措辞均自然，步骤和对照列表有实际用途，没有无效模板，整体收益接近。

execution.note: 16 editing calls, eight primary anonymous judging calls, and four swapped-order follow-ups. No retry or derived output batches.

maintenance_checks.unit_tests: Not rerun: no packaging or maintenance code changed in this round.

judging_calibration.prior_checks: Seven R3 calibration checks matched their predeclared expectations; these were not rerun and are not counted as R4 calls or skill passes.
judging_calibration.note: Order sensitivity on actual comparisons shows that passing simple calibration does not guarantee stable stylistic preferences.

review_method: Independent fresh-session model judgments plus maintaining-agent inspection of source and both generated outputs. Holdout inputs were not displayed to the maintaining agent until the candidate had been committed; the candidate remained unchanged thereafter.
limitations: Eight independent synthetic inputs: seven issue/PR tasks and one unrelated expressive-writing case. Four inputs were held out.
One generation per version and case, with one initial judge and one additional order-swapped judgment on non-ties. Not a failure-rate or aggregate superiority estimate.
Order swaps changed all four non-tie preferences to ties; this design cannot separate position effects from ordinary model variability.
The same model family generated and judged outputs. No human author or professional editor blind review occurred.
No measured review-time or merge-quality improvement; language quality does not identify AI authorship.
All R4 cases are consumed for future rounds. Unrelated writing, other Chinese varieties and other model families have limited or no coverage here.
The required-template case supplied validation facts. A template with completely missing validation evidence remains a useful separate test.
This text-only round did not rerun all permanent cases or test live repository investigation, command execution, file editing or publication.
next_evidence: Collect real author or maintainer revisions with permission, paying attention to what they keep as well as delete.
Use fresh cases for required fields with missing evidence, implementation histories and descriptions based on a final diff.
Keep current scope and language protections; do not add rules solely to favor one formatting preference in these consumed examples.
